propositions: Define a provider-neutral immutable logical-operation outcome contract with exact enums (Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, DelaySource) to unify retry behavior across Cloud and Jira DC adapters.
Implement a sole three-invocation, 15-second fake-clock retry budget owner in the reconciler domain that centralizes sleep and replay decisions while preserving additive-jitter semantics.

Serialize outcome values to byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON via canonical_bytes with chronological diagnostic entries (max eight, with truncation sentinel on overflow) and redacted messages capped at 512 Unicode code points.

After ambiguous writes, observe the desired primary-store postcondition before replay; if observed, return recovered; if inconclusive or failed, return non-replaying commit_unknown with forbidden replay safety.

Reject delays that exceed remaining sleep budget by returning retry_not_before without incrementing invocation or request counters, and cap per-invocation attempt at three with zero-based retry indexes producing schedule [2s,3s) then [4s,5s).

Define logical_id as one canonical UUID retained across every invocation, and ensure diagnostic allowlist admits only stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message while excluding headers, bodies, credentials, and ticket content.
